dataset: HIPAA BAA Vendor Tracker — AI tools
description: Which AI tools will sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and are usable with Protected Health Information (PHI). Every verdict is cited to a vendor primary source and date-stamped.

fields.phi_eligible: yes | conditional | no | unknown — may PHI be processed?
fields.how_to_get_baa: How / on which tier a BAA is obtained (or why none exists)
fields.baa_last_verified: ISO date the source was last confirmed
fields.source_url: Vendor/HHS primary source for the verdict
fields.atlas_url: Per-vendor detail page on BAA Atlas

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Gemini for Workspace is a HIPAA-covered service under the Google Workspace BAA. A Workspace admin must accept the BAA in the Admin console; the free consumer Gemini app is not covered.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is permitted in Gemini for Workspace once a Workspace admin has accepted the Google Workspace BAA — not in the free consumer Gemini app.

vendors.baa_verdict: Only on a qualifying (usually enterprise) tier
vendors.how_to_get_baa: BAA available on ChatGPT Enterprise, the API platform, and the new ChatGPT for Healthcare (launched Jan 2026). Free, Plus and Pro consumer plans are excluded and cannot get a BAA.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is permitted only on a BAA-covered Enterprise, API or ChatGPT-for-Healthcare account — never on Free, Plus or Pro.

vendors.baa_verdict: Only on a qualifying (usually enterprise) tier
vendors.how_to_get_baa: A BAA is available on Claude for Enterprise (and commercial/API agreements). Consumer Claude (Free, Pro, Max) is not BAA-covered.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is permitted only on a BAA-covered Claude for Enterprise (or commercial/API) agreement — never on consumer Claude.

vendors.baa_verdict: Only on a qualifying (usually enterprise) tier
vendors.how_to_get_baa: Windsurf/Codeium's security page states it is maintained HIPAA-compliant and will entertain a BAA for significant (enterprise) implementations with zero-data-retention by default on Teams/Enterprise; the standard MSA, however, disclaims that the Offerings meet HIPAA, so a BAA must be separately negotiated.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is permissible only under a separately negotiated BAA on a qualifying enterprise implementation — the default subscription disclaims HIPAA.

vendors.baa_verdict: Only on a qualifying (usually enterprise) tier
vendors.how_to_get_baa: ElevenLabs executes a BAA only for Enterprise subscriptions, which must run a HIPAA-compliant configuration with Zero Retention Mode enabled; customers contact Sales to sign the BAA before handling PHI.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is permitted only on an ElevenLabs Enterprise plan with a signed BAA and Zero Retention Mode engaged.

vendors.baa_verdict: Only on a qualifying (usually enterprise) tier
vendors.how_to_get_baa: Grammarly enters a BAA only on Grammarly Business Enterprise plans with a 100-seat minimum; individual and smaller paid plans are not BAA-eligible and must not handle PHI.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is permitted only on a Grammarly Business Enterprise plan (100+ seats) with a signed BAA in place.
vendors.source_title: Is Grammarly HIPAA compliant? — Grammarly Support

vendors.baa_verdict: Only on a qualifying (usually enterprise) tier
vendors.how_to_get_baa: Covered by Microsoft's HIPAA BAA when run inside an eligible Microsoft 365 enterprise tenant (E3/E5, Business Premium). Consumer and unlicensed add-on tiers are excluded.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is permitted only when Microsoft 365 Copilot runs inside a BAA-covered M365 enterprise tenant (E3/E5 or Business Premium).
vendors.source_title: Enterprise data protection in Microsoft 365 Copilot — Microsoft Learn

vendors.baa_verdict: Only on a qualifying (usually enterprise) tier
vendors.how_to_get_baa: A BAA is available on Otter Enterprise only. Basic, Pro and Business plans cannot execute a BAA.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is permitted only on Otter Enterprise with a signed BAA — never on Basic, Pro or Business.

vendors.baa_verdict: Only on a qualifying (usually enterprise) tier
vendors.how_to_get_baa: Slack signs a BAA only for Enterprise Grid; once configured for HIPAA, PHI may appear in messages and file uploads that Slack AI operates on within Slack's trust boundary, while third-party marketplace apps stay excluded.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI with Slack AI is permitted only on Slack Enterprise Grid once a BAA is signed and the workspace is HIPAA-configured.
vendors.source_title: Slack and HIPAA — Slack Help Center

vendors.baa_verdict: Only on a qualifying (usually enterprise) tier
vendors.how_to_get_baa: Notion signs a BAA only on the Enterprise plan (100+ members), and the Notion AI add-on is explicitly carved out of that BAA — so PHI may never be processed through Notion AI even on an Enterprise BAA.
vendors.phi_verdict: Even with a Notion Enterprise BAA, the Notion AI add-on is excluded, so do not put PHI into Notion AI.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: HIPAA compliance and a BAA are available on request for qualifying (paid) plans, executed via Fireflies' Data Processing Agreement.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is permitted once a BAA is requested and signed on a qualifying paid plan.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: xAI can sign a BAA for Enterprise customers after a BAA questionnaire, and PHI must be sent only via xAI's ZDR-enabled API; consumer Grok has no BAA.
vendors.phi_verdict: PHI is allowed only via xAI's ZDR-enabled Enterprise API after xAI reviews your questionnaire and signs a BAA — never in consumer Grok.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Tabnine fits HIPAA workflows via its Enterprise self-hosted, VPC, on-prem and air-gapped deployments with zero code retention, where customer code never reaches Tabnine's servers; a BAA is handled through enterprise engagement rather than a self-serve click-through.
vendors.phi_verdict: Tabnine suits HIPAA use only via its self-hosted/air-gapped Enterprise deployment where you retain full data control — not the default SaaS tier.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Adobe acts as a Business Associate only for designated HIPAA-Ready Services (e.g. Acrobat Sign Enterprise and select Document/Experience Cloud capabilities); Firefly is a creative generative-AI app and is not a HIPAA-Ready Service, so no Firefly BAA is available.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not process PHI in Adobe Firefly — Adobe's BAA covers only its HIPAA-Ready services, which do not include Firefly.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: AWS signs a single BAA covering eligible services, but Amazon Q Developer is NOT on the AWS HIPAA Eligible Services Reference list (only Amazon Q Business is); AWS states Q Developer is not designed to transmit, store or process ePHI.
vendors.phi_verdict: Even under an executed AWS BAA, do not use ePHI with Amazon Q Developer — it is not a HIPAA-eligible service.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Canva does not sign a BAA on any plan, including Canva Enterprise; its Trust Center offers only GDPR-oriented Data Processing Addendums, not a HIPAA BAA.
vendors.phi_verdict: Use Canva for non-PHI content only — it will not sign a BAA, so designing or uploading protected health information is non-compliant.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Character.AI is a consumer entertainment chatbot with no HIPAA BAA and no healthcare/enterprise compliance tier; users are advised not to share sensitive or medical data.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not enter PHI into Character.AI — it is a consumer product with no BAA and is not HIPAA-ready.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Copy.ai is a marketing/GTM writing tool whose public security and trust materials address general data privacy (SOC 2 / GDPR / CCPA style) but contain no HIPAA compliance statement or BAA offering.
vendors.phi_verdict: Copy.ai publishes no HIPAA BAA, so this general marketing-copy tool should not be used with protected health information.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Cursor (Anysphere) does not publicly offer a BAA on any plan — Free, Pro, Business or Enterprise — and its terms contain no HIPAA provisions; healthcare teams are directed to contact sales but no BAA is documented.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not route PHI through Cursor — without a BAA, any PHI in prompts, indexed files or test data is a HIPAA exposure.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: DeepSeek publishes no HIPAA BAA and offers no HIPAA-compliant tier; data is stored in the People's Republic of China and the product carries no compliance or transparency guarantees for healthcare use.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not use DeepSeek with PHI — no BAA is offered, data is stored in China, and it is not HIPAA-ready.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Descript's published compliance program (security page, SecurityPal trust center) covers SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA and Privacy by Design but lists no HIPAA attestation and offers no BAA on any plan, including Enterprise.
vendors.phi_verdict: Descript publishes no HIPAA BAA, so its audio/video editor should not be used to process protected health information.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: GitHub Copilot is explicitly outside Microsoft's HIPAA BAA scope — it is not a BAA-covered service even on enterprise GitHub plans.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not enter PHI into GitHub Copilot — it is excluded from Microsoft's HIPAA BAA coverage.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: NotebookLM is absent from Google Workspace's 'HIPAA Included Functionality' list, so it is not covered by the Google Workspace HIPAA BAA; the free consumer app is likewise out of scope.
vendors.phi_verdict: NotebookLM is excluded from the Google Workspace HIPAA BAA and its Included Functionality list, so do not use it with PHI.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: The Jasper marketing platform's security documentation advises against entering protected health information and offers no BAA; the separately-owned, unrelated 'Jasper Health' company is the only Jasper-named entity that signs BAAs.
vendors.phi_verdict: Jasper's marketing platform tells users not to input PHI and signs no BAA, so it is not suitable for protected health information.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Meta does not sign a HIPAA BAA for any of its products, including Meta AI; it is a consumer service not designed for PHI and has faced enforcement over health-data handling.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not enter PHI into Meta AI — Meta does not sign a BAA and the product is not HIPAA-ready.
vendors.source_title: Generative AI at Meta — Privacy Center

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Consumer Microsoft Copilot (the free / web Copilot) is excluded from Microsoft's HIPAA BAA — only Microsoft 365 enterprise Copilot is covered.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not enter PHI into consumer Microsoft Copilot — it is outside the Microsoft BAA; use a BAA-covered M365 enterprise tenant instead.
vendors.source_title: Privacy FAQ for Microsoft Copilot — Microsoft Support

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Midjourney is a consumer creative image-generation service with no security/compliance program and no BAA offering on any tier; it does not execute HIPAA BAAs.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not put any PHI into Midjourney — it does not sign a BAA and is intended for general creative use only.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Mistral does not publish a HIPAA BAA for Le Chat (including Le Chat Enterprise); a GDPR DPA and API Zero Data Retention exist but are not a BAA. HIPAA-grade use is only attainable by self-hosting the open-weight models yourself.
vendors.phi_verdict: Le Chat is not HIPAA-ready and Mistral signs no BAA for it; PHI is only viable if you self-host the open-weight models in your own environment.
vendors.source_title: Regulatory Compliance and Certification — Mistral AI Help Center

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Perplexity does not sign a BAA — not even on Enterprise Pro. There is no HIPAA-covered Perplexity tier.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not enter PHI into Perplexity — it does not sign a BAA on any plan, including Enterprise Pro.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Poe (by Quora) is a consumer multi-model chatbot aggregator with no HIPAA BAA; its privacy policy warns against sharing sensitive information and shares chats with third-party model providers and bot developers.
vendors.phi_verdict: Do not enter PHI into Poe — no BAA is offered and chats are shared with third-party model providers.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: QuillBot's Trust Center commits to GDPR, CCPA and PCI DSS but lists no HIPAA compliance or BAA offering; third-party aggregator claims of 'HIPAA compliant' are not corroborated by QuillBot's first-party documentation.
vendors.phi_verdict: QuillBot's official trust documentation offers no HIPAA BAA, so this writing/paraphrasing tool should not handle protected health information.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Replit does not offer a BAA or advertise HIPAA eligibility, and its 2026 Commercial Agreement and DPA add no HIPAA/BAA terms; it also lacks HIPAA controls such as PHI-safe isolation, audit logs and breach alerting.
vendors.phi_verdict: Replit AI is for synthetic/test-data prototyping only — with no BAA it cannot lawfully store or process real PHI.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Sourcegraph's published compliance program covers SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR and CCPA but lists no HIPAA attestation and offers no BAA; Cody is a developer code-AI product not positioned for PHI.
vendors.phi_verdict: Cody offers no HIPAA BAA, so it should not be used to process protected health information.

vendors.how_to_get_baa: Zoom signs a BAA for Meetings, Phone and Team Chat on eligible plans, but AI Companion's generative features (notes, summaries, transcription, chatbot) are excluded from standard BAA coverage and are auto-restricted when a BAA is active.
vendors.phi_verdict: Zoom AI Companion is carved out of the standard Zoom BAA, so do not process PHI through it unless your BAA names it in writing.
vendors.source_title: Health Data & HIPAA Compliance — Zoom Trust Center
